description:
I am a Marketing & Communication Strategist and Sales Enablement Marketer with 25+ years of experience helping IT firms, startups, and SMEs drive growth through integrated go-to-market, branding, and visibility strategies. I specialize in bridging sales and marketing, designing 360° campaigns, and building leadership visibility that positions CXOs and organizations as trusted thought leaders.

Alongside industry consulting, I actively contribute to entrepreneurship education in premium institutions, designing practical curricula and authoring learning resources on Entrepreneurship and Marketing & Communications. I also work closely with organizations on Good Company, Good Culture initiatives, enabling leadership excellence, engaged teams, and sustainable growth.

Purpose: To catalyze organizational and leadership growth by blending Strategic Marketing, Sales Enablement, Leadership Development, and Culture Coaching—helping businesses scale with impact, visibility, and integrity.
